cards.front: What is the most common cause of heart failure?
cards.back: Coronary artery disease (accounts for 50-60% of cases)
Beta-blockers — they reduce myocardial oxygen demand by decreasing heart rate and contractility

cards.front: Most common cause of secondary hypertension in young adults
cards.back: Primary aldosteronism (Conn syndrome) — suspect in resistant hypertension with hypokalemia

cards.front: Triple therapy for HFrEF with strongest mortality benefit
cards.back: ACE inhibitor (or ARB) + Beta-blocker + Aldosterone antagonist
